_provenance.title: An epigenetic biomarker of aging for lifespan and healthspan
_provenance.main_text_table: Table 1. Phenotypic aging measures and Gompertz coefficients.
_provenance.supplementary_table_s1: Supplementary Table S1 — same biomarker weights as Table 1 plus Constant and Gamma for the Gompertz PH model.
notes: Biomarker + age weights are the published Gompertz linear predictor coefficients (Supplementary Table S1 / main text Table 1), not the penalized Cox selection betas.
x_b = Constant + sum(weight_i * marker_i), with CRP as natural log in mg/dL.
10-year mortality risk: MortalityScore_j = CDF(120 months, x_j) = 1 - exp(-exp(x_b) * (exp(120*gamma) - 1) / gamma), with t in months per Supplementary Methods.
Phenotypic age (years): PhenotypicAge_j = 141.50225 + ln(-0.00553 * ln(1 - MortalityScore_j)) / 0.090165 (Supplementary Methods, step 4).
Gamma is given as 0.0076927 in Supplementary Methods text; Supplementary Table S1 lists Gamma 0.0077 (rounded).

CRP log base (Methods vs Table S1): Supplementary Table S1 labels CRP as log(mg/dL) without specifying log10 vs ln. Supplementary Methods for PhenotypicAge use natural-log steps in surrounding equations. Reference stacks (NHANES BioAge / R BioAge) treat PhenoAge CRP as ln(mg/dL). This repo locks transform to natural_log (see biomarkers[].transform). If future primary-source erratum specifies log10, update transform + tests.
